# NFL Daily — 2026-11-16 (Past 1 day(s))

## Summary
- Patriots QB Drake Maye suffered a fractured ankle on the same sack that ended Lions DE Aidan Hutchinson's season, and could miss the rest of the year. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50500352/patriots-qb-drake-maye-leg-miss-extended-sources-say)
- Lions DE Aidan Hutchinson tore his ACL during a sack celebration and is out for the season. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50501291/sources-aidan-hutchinson-season-torn-acl)
- Bengals QB Joe Burrow threw four touchdowns in a 38-18 rout of the Steelers, becoming only the third player ever (after Tom Brady and Peyton Manning) to throw 20+ TD passes across a five-game span — Cincinnati takes the AFC North lead. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50499235/bengals-joe-burrow-4-touchdowns-win-vs-steelers-puts-company-tom-brady-peyton-manning)
- Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald reaffirmed Sam Darnold as the starting QB over red-hot backup Drew Lock, who is 4-0 as a starter this season, heading into Seattle's bye. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7787356/2026/11/16/sam-darnold-drew-lock-seahawks-qb-controversy/)

## Transactions
- _No qualifying transactions in this window._

## Injuries
- Vikings WR Jordan Addison needs thumb surgery and is a candidate for IR, expected to miss about four weeks. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50503437/vikings-wr-jordan-addison-needs-thumb-surgery)
- Cowboys starters RG Tyler Booker and CB DaRon Bland are each dealing with high-ankle sprains that could cost them multiple weeks. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50502772/sources-cowboys-rg-booker-cb-bland-high-ankle-sprains)
- Packers DE Micah Parsons is still targeting a Week 12 return (Nov. 25 vs. the Rams) after clearing a few more hurdles. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2122422330269843696)
- Raiders TE Brock Bowers avoided a major ankle injury and is considered day-to-day. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50501232/raiders-te-brock-bowers-avoids-major-ankle-injury-source-says)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-11-16 (Past 1 day(s))

## Key news
- QB Jacoby Brissett made his Ravens debut Monday night against the Chargers, becoming Baltimore's fourth different starting quarterback in four games with Lamar Jackson still out. [Hensley](https://x.com/jamisonhensley/status/2122392040642113684)
- The Ravens, in the midst of the worst three-game stretch in franchise history, called their mini-bye a "reset" under coach Jesse Minter heading into Monday night. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7783631/2026/11/16/ravens-chargers-mnf-week-10-mini-bye-reset/)
- Kicker Riley Patterson also made his Ravens debut Monday night, the latest roster churn during Baltimore's injury-plagued season. [Hensley](https://x.com/jamisonhensley/status/2122376947749552172)
